title: Analysis code and derived results for: Is Genetic Liability to Anxiety-Related Primary-Care Consultation Associated with Chronic Neck-Shoulder Pain? A Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization Study with Implications for Physiotherapy Assessment
description: Analysis code (R/Python) and derived result tables for a two-sample Mendelian randomization study of genetic liability to anxiety-related primary-care consultation and chronic neck-shoulder pain, including an exploratory outcome-side cross-design analysis using FinnGen R12 endpoints. The manuscript reports an association rather than a causal relationship. Input data are publicly available GWAS summary statistics from IEU OpenGWAS and the FinnGen public release; no individual-level data were used.
